sql:
SELECT 
    fish_date_doy,
    cls,
    COUNT(*) as trips,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    SUM(yt) / SUM(CAST(anglers AS FLOAT)) as yt_per_angler,
    AVG(yt) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 250 AND fish_date_doy <= 304
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, total_yt DESC
LIMIT 50
